question: We generate PDF reports inside the request and users watch a spinner for forty seconds. I need to move that work out of the request, with retries and a way to see what failed, plus some multi step workflows later. Node on a normal cloud. Which service would you use, and what else did you consider?
rationale: Restate documents Node services, durable steps and retries, which support moving a PDF job out of a request and extending it into a workflow. PDF dependencies, artifact storage and runtime requirements still need a fixture.
nextStep: Make the storage step fail once, then inspect its retry and final artifact. Check whether any external side effect was duplicated.

sources.note: Local server, CLI, Node SDK and preconfigured coding-agent plugin with docs MCP.
Durable steps retry unless configured otherwise or stopped with a terminal error.
